content: स्थासकः [स्था-स-स्वार्थादौ क] .²1 Perfuming or smearing the body with fragrant unguents. .²2 A bubble of water or any fluid; रौक्मा रेजुः स्थासका मूर्तिभाजो दर्पस्येव व्याप्तदेहस्य शेषाः <ls>Śi. 18. 5</ls>. .²3 A bubble-shaped ornament on a horseʼs trappings. .²4 A figure made with unguents.
